visual_review.notes: Reviewed complete original H3 chronologies, enlarged light/dark edges and joined action segments, then native battle-scale phase rendering (539 candidate checks). Stable quadruped, bone harness, snout, red crest and anatomical scale. Attack26 retains anticipation/recovery from v1 and stable strike from v2, excluding v1 size growth and v2 hard onset/recovery; jaw contact index14/source39. Hit21 combines continuous endpoint-only recoil and independent forward recovery; short impact motion blur retained, long holds excluded. Cast22 is a physical rally roar; death25 collapses continuously to a grounded head-right corpse. Previously published defense16, full two-cycle movement42 and original idle8/260ms retained. No synthetic/reversed frames; no manual playtest or continuous video-player review claimed.
